channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lauri Markkanen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lauri Markkanen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Terry on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
said Terry in a one-on-one interview with RG of Jackson.

“But he also stretches the floor and can shoot with high efficiency from three. We love his versatility. Obviously, we know what he does defensively as a rim protector, but his offensive versatility combined with (Lauri) Markkanen, it is a tough, tough combo.”

Jason Terry on Lauri Markkanen, Mar 5, 2026. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Jason Terry on Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Terry spoke glowingly of the potential of a Jackson-Markkanen backcourt, two All-Stars that will be leading the way for the Jazz.

“We're a young team, we're rebuilding, but just made a move at the deadline to get Jaren Jackson Jr, appearing with Lauri Markkanen, which gives us one of the one of the most dominant front courts in the league,”

Jason Terry on Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr, Mar 5, 2026. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Vassilis Spanoulis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Lauri Markkanen, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Vassilis Spanoulis:

“At least to times, he should have been awarded unsportmanlike fouls, and we have to face everybody with the same criteria. If we face Luka, Jokic, and Sengun, Markkanen, like this, we have to face Giannis the same way. Just 12 free throws are few for Giannis; he could have had another 10 for sure. We have a team in which we respect everybody, and first of all, me, as a person, I respect a lot coach Scariolo and Spain, which has accomplished amazing things over the last 15 years, but I have to be fair with myself and the game, and to say the truth”

Vassilis Spanoulis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Lauri Markkanen, Alperen Sengun, Sep 4, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Draymond Green on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Draymond Green told ESPN earlier this month.

“Markkanen coming here, we don't know. We have never seen it. So there was no thought of what could have been because we don't know what that look like.”

Draymond Green on Lauri Markkanen, Oct 29, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Justin Zanik on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Jazz GM Justin Zanik said.

“In this organization, we are extremely aggressive with pursuing any and all means necessary to make this a championship-caliber roster. When those opportunities come up, we’re ready for it. There weren’t any. “And so to sit there and not do anything, we decided that our plan was to completely throw our focus into our young guys and the best player on our roster in Lauri Markkanen.”

Justin Zanik on Lauri Markkanen, Sep 29, 2024. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Lauri Markkanen:

“He’s the closest thing that I've seen to Nowitzki in terms of a seven footer that can really stretch the game out and play inside.”

Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Lauri Markkanen, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Domantas Sabonis on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Domantas Sabonis on the last play with Lauri Markkanen:

“Once I saw him catch it with his back to the basket, I didn't worry because he has to catch it and turn around. I was like, 'Whatever'. But then you know... we're the Kings and I was like... Well, we might have lost.”

Domantas Sabonis on Lauri Markkanen, Jan 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Patrick Williams on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Patrick Williams on likely matchup with former teammate Lauri Markkanen:

“It’ll definitely be fun. I’ve been watching the games, and I know he’s playing really well. Proud of him on that end. He knows what I bring. And I know what he brings. So I think it will be a good battle.”

Patrick Williams on Lauri Markkanen, Nov 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Malik Beasley on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Malik Beasley on @Utah Jazz teammate Lauri Markkanen:

“He's an All-Star, I've preached that and I want him to get that this year.”

Malik Beasley on Lauri Markkanen, Nov 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Lauri Markkanen, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Law Murray:Nicolas Batum on Evan Mobley and gargantuan Cavaliers lineup:

“They got Markkanen at the 3, right? So I mean, that's unusual for sure. But you know, we got to face that to find a way to win this game. Mobley's doing great things for a youngster...”

Nicolas Batum on Lauri Markkanen, Evan Mobley, Oct 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Kobi Altman on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
“We are extremely fortunate as an organization to be in a position to acquire another young and talented player with the skill-set of Lauri Markkanen,”

Kobi Altman on Lauri Markkanen, Aug 28, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
“I can tell you the Wolves have kicked the tires on Paul Millsap, on Josh Hart, on Dennis Schroeder, on Lauri Markkanen,”

Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen, Aug 10, 2021. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Artūras Karnišovas:

“We like Lauri (Markkanen) and we would like him to be part of this organization for a long time... We're going to make every effort to get [an extension] done.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Lauri Markkanen, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Zach LaVine, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
“He had three egregious defensive mistakes. .?.?. Zach LaVine and Lauri Markkanen and our starters have to play better. That’s how it works.”

Jim Boylen on Zach LaVine, Lauri Markkanen, Nov 23, 2019. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Jabari Parker on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Jabari Parker on Markkanen injury:

“It's deflating because that’s one of our key pieces. And I think that’s just going to put us behind, especially me trying to figure out chemistry. But as long as he is around then we’re going to try to do it another way instead of on the court”

Jabari Parker on Lauri Markkanen, Sep 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Wendell Carter Jr on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Carter Jr. on Markkanen:

“He’s a fantastic young player, someone I can learn from on and off the court.”

Wendell Carter Jr on Lauri Markkanen, Jun 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Bulls coachFred Hoiberg on the cream of this rookie class:

“I’ll put Lauri [Markkanen] up there with any of them. We wouldn’t trade him for anybody.”

Fred Hoiberg on Lauri Markkanen, Jan 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on Lauri Markkanen and Dirk comparisons:

“You know, 7-foot guys from foreign countries that can make shots from everywhere are going to get compared to Dirk Nowitzki. That's going to be a fact of life.”

Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Lauri Markkanen, Jan 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Jay Triano on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Suns interim coachJay Triano on Lauri Markkanen:

“He's going to be a great player. He is a good player now. Our scouting reports today are concerned about how are we going to stop him,how we're not going to let him get comfortable.”

Jay Triano on Lauri Markkanen, Nov 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Wade on Markkanen:

“You can see if a guy knows how to play basketball when you first see him. In the preseason, we all said he can play.”

Dwyane Wade on Lauri Markkanen, Oct 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
